num_weeks = 8
num_groups = 8
group_size = 3

# Variables: group[w][g] = group assignment for golfer g in week w
group = [[z3.Int(f"g_{w}_{g}") for g in range(num_golfers)] for w in range(num_weeks)]

solver = z3.Solver()

# Each group variable ranges 0..7
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for g in range(num_golfers):
        solver.add(group[w][g] >= 0, group[w][g] < num_groups)

# Each group has exactly 3 golfers each week
# Use pseudo-boolean constraints via sum of indicator variables
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for k in range(num_groups):
        # Exactly 3 golfers in group k
        indicators = [z3.If(group[w][g] == k, 1, 0) for g in range(num_golfers)]
        solver.add(z3.Sum(indicators) == group_size)

# No pair meets more than once
# For each pair (g1, g2), they can be in the same group at most once
for g1 in range(num_golfers):
    for g2 in range(g1+1, num_golfers):
        same_group = [z3.If(group[w][g1] == group[w][g2], 1, 0) for w in range(num_weeks)]
        solver.add(z3.Sum(same_group) <= 1)

print("Constraints added. Solving with Z3...")
# Set a timeout
solver.set("timeout", 300000)  # 300 seconds
result = solver.check()
print("Result:", result)

if result == z3.sat:
    model = solver.model()
    solution = []

            solution.append(model.evaluate(group[w][g]).as_long())
    print("Solution:", solution)
